'''Emirates Flight Catering''' ({{langx|ar|الإمارات لتموين الطائرات}}) (EKFC) is an in-flight catering service based in [[Dubai]], [[United Arab Emirates]], which provides catering and support services for the [[Emirates (airline)|Emirates]] airline and all other airlines based at [[Dubai International Airport]]. It is a subsidiary of [[The Emirates Group]].

EKFC directly employs over 11,000 staff, and operates from the Emirates Flight Catering Centre which can produce over 225,000 meals daily. The Company provided 55 million meals in 2017, with an average daily meal uplift of 180,000.<ref name="ekcat">{{cite web |title=Airline Catering Dubai - Emirates Flight Catering |url=https://www.emiratesflightcatering.com/services/airline-catering/ |website=www.emiratesflightcatering.com |accessdate=21 February 2019}}</ref>

==History==
[[File:Emirates Flight Catering (1).jpg|thumb|left|Emirates Flight Catering at Dubai International Airport]]
Emirates Flight Catering was formed out of Emirates Abela Catering Company in 2003. It now produces more than 55 million meals per year and has a fleet of 295 high loader trucks and 89 special vehicle for the [[Airbus A380]].<ref name="ekcat"></ref>

In July 2005, EKFC began operations at its new Food Point facility, a {{convert|10000|m²|0|abbr=on}} facility capable of producing 30 million meals annually.<ref>{{cite web |title=Food Production Dubai I Emirates Flight Catering |url=https://www.emiratesflightcatering.com/services/food-production/ |website=www.emiratesflightcatering.com |accessdate=21 February 2019}}</ref>

In early 2006, EKFC began operations at a new catering facility dedicated to service flights on [[Emirates (airline)|Emirates]]. The facility can produce over 115,000 meals daily. The older facility is now used to serve all 120 of the international airlines operating out of Dubai Airport, as well as providing catering for 25 lounges at Dubai Airports.<ref name="ekcat"/> Also in 2006, EKFC expanded its Linencraft laundering plant.<ref name="arablinen">{{cite web |title=Linencraft lights the way|url=https://www.arabianbusiness.com/linencraft-lights-way-200999.html|website=www.arabianbusiness.com |accessdate=21 February 2019}}</ref>

February 19, 2024 - Emirates Flight Catering completed the full acquisition of Emirates Bustanica, previously known as Emirates Crop One. Bustanica, its consumer brand, is recognized as the largest indoor [[vertical farm]] in the world.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Emirates Flight Catering acquires world’s largest indoor vertical farm - Business Traveller
 |url= https://www.businesstraveller.com/business-travel/2024/02/20/emirates-flight-catering-acquires-worlds-largest-indoor-vertical-farm/ |access-date=2024-09-10 |website= businesstraveller.com }}</ref>

==Subsidiaries==
[[File:DXB on 23 September 2007 Pict 10.jpg|thumb|left|Emirates Flight Catering at Dubai International Airport]]

===Food Point===
Food Point is a catering facility based at [[Dubai Investment Park]] that opened in July 2005. It is another food production facility, and can produce over 30 million meals annually. Food Point was designed and its project managed by [[Europe|European]] Projects, a [[United Kingdom|UK]]-based specialist food design company that has since become International Food Systems Ltd.<ref>{{cite web |title=Emirates - IFS |url=http://internationalfoodsystems.com/emirates/ |website=International Food Systems Ltd. |accessdate=21 February 2019 |date=27 June 2018}}</ref>

===Linencraft===
Linencraft is a laundering facility with a total area of {{convert|10500|m²|0|abbr=on}}<ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-05-22 |title=Emirates Flight Catering Careers Apply Now |url=https://www.gulfjobnew.com/2018/04/emirates-flight-catering-careers-apply.html |access-date=2024-11-06 |website=GULFJOBNEW.COM |language=en}}</ref> located at Dubai Investment Park. Since the expansion to a processing volume of up to 80 tons per day in 2007, the facility is now able to process 210 tons of laundry and dry cleaning output per day.<ref name="linen">{{cite web |title=Laundry Services Dubai I Emirates Flight Catering |url=https://www.emiratesflightcatering.com/services/laundry/ |website=www.emiratesflightcatering.com |accessdate=21 February 2019}}</ref><ref name="arablinen"></ref>
